_comment: Copy to publisher-config.json. One publisher stack per publisher AWS account.
_github_publish_repos_note: Repo names in github_org that may assume the publish role. Use ["*"] for the whole org, or list repos (mail, scheduler, …).
_reader_aws_accounts_note: AWS accounts allowed to pip/npm install from this publisher registry (customer or partner accounts). Empty = same-account only. Cross-account still needs IAM in the reader account (see README).
_account_region_note: Account and region are not in this file. Templates are env-agnostic (AWS::AccountId / AWS::Region). Choose them at deploy time (AWS profile / CLI region).
